steps.description: Amend docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md: insert step 3.6 (rehydrate completed-stage artifacts; absent artifact after restore causes exit 1) and add enforcing test names (resume-rehydrate-test.sh, resume-entry-points-test.sh) inline; step 3.5 covers cycle_iterations amendment — use 3.6 to avoid collision
Amend docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6: add boundary note that resume (same run, ADR-006) is distinct from new-run reuse (ADR-050 §6 governs)
Add _artifact_persist_put_back <from> <to> to core/state/artifact-persist.sh (no-clobber copy skipping stage-io/); body identical to current _hydrate_put_back
Redirect plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh _hydrate_put_back call site to _artifact_persist_put_back (hydrate already sources artifact-persist.sh)
Update tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh: redirect the direct _hydrate_put_back call at line 216 to _artifact_persist_put_back

Fix _cycle_orchestrator_run_body in core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh: replace the current unconditional block at lines 2305–2309 (local _persisted_iter … local _start_iter=$(( _persisted_iter + 1 ))) with: `if [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]]; then local _persisted_iter; _persisted_iter="$(get_state_field "$state_file" ".cycle_iterations[\"$cycle_id\"].current_iter" 0 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"; [[ "$_persisted_iter" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || _persisted_iter=0; local _start_iter=$(( _persisted_iter + 1 )); else local _start_iter=1; fi` — when not in resume mode, _start_iter is always 1, restoring correct behaviour for fresh runs and nested-loop re-entries

In runner.sh, add `export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` on the line immediately after the _runner_resume_rehydrate call at runner.sh:2838 (before the eb_emit_event "pipeline.resume" call at line 2839); do NOT set it for fresh runs (the else branch at line 2845)

Confirm tests/integration/cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, tests/integration/nested-loop-rounds-test.sh, tests/integration/nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh, and tests/integration/cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh pass after the guard fix (they were broken by the unconditional current_iter read)

Update tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh: add `export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` before the cycle_orchestrator_run call (the test calls the orchestrator directly, bypassing runner.sh; without this the guard at step 6 prevents reading current_iter and SPEC-7 "first dispatched iter is 2" fails); replace the "no iter=1 complete" zero-count assertion using grep-c with `wc -l | tr -d ' '`

Update tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh — four targeted changes in order: (1) Fix the four grep-c anti-pattern sites: at each of lines ~139, ~225, ~312, ~527 replace `| grep -c '^...$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0` with `| wc -l | tr -d ' '`; (2) add `--no-resume` flag to the SPEC-12 runner invocation (line ~516) to prevent auto-resume (status=interrupted + recent timestamp triggers auto_resume); (3) remove the entire SPEC-12 cycled-dispatch block — the `_s12_cycled_starts` initialisation, the jq pipe, and the `assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage"` assertion (the cycled sub-stage does not dispatch in full runner runs of the artifact-snapshot-coverage fixture); (4) remove the entire SPEC-13 section at the end of the file — the `print_test_section "resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"` line and the two assertions that follow it (`assert_contains "resume-rehydrate fixture contains type: cycle"` and `assert_gt "resume-rehydrate: pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)"`) — these are UNTAGGED remnants of SPEC-13 that are now dropped

Update tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh: fix the SPEC-3 "intake emits no stage.start" zero-count assertion — replace `| grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0` with `| wc -l | tr -d ' '`

Update tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh: remove any `[#1805/SPEC-13]`-tagged assertions AND any untagged `assert_gt` assertions that check cycled sub-stage dispatch counts (no requirement mandates that cycled dispatches in full runner runs); intake-dispatched assertions and type:cycle fixture content checks tagged under a valid SPEC may remain

Update tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh: pre-write intake's primary artifact to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the --resume run so SPEC-2 fail-closed path does not break the existing exit-0 assertion

Update tests/integration/resume-after-sigint-test.sh: ensure the Phase 1 intake stub writes intake-result.json; if the stub from mock_plugin_factory does not write it, replace with a stub that does; confirm P2.T1 (rc=0) still passes
Run npm test and confirm full suite green
